meta.measures: Which map nodes are actually being measured right now.
meta.why_this_can_mislead: This reports whether a node is measured, never whether the measurement is sound. A collector pointed at the wrong data still reads MEASURED. Verdicts also depend on the freshness window: widen it and STALE nodes silently become MEASURED again without anything having been collected.

bph.label: Bulletproof Hosting
bph.note: Routing, registry standing, and whether live malware infrastructure currently sits on the provider's own address space. The last of those measures use rather than existence, which the others cannot see.

vpn.label: VPN / Anonymity Providers
vpn.reason: Provider population is enumerable from the same routing and registry sources already in use. Not built.

forums.label: Underground Forums
forums.reason: Covered by scoreboard.json, which a person maintains. Nothing would announce it going stale.

crypters.label: Crypters and Packers
crypters.note: Obfuscation technique prevalence only. The crypter service market has no public source.

callers.label: Callers and Spammers
callers.reason: Voice calls leave no artifact. Callback-phishing lure volume exists in commercial email telemetry, which is Tier 2, not public.

loaders.label: Loaders and Botnets
loaders.note: Live botnet command servers by malware family, ecosystem-wide. Counts what is reported, which is uneven and volunteer-driven.

stealers.label: Stealers and Log Markets
stealers.note: Only incidentally, through malware family signatures on wrapped samples. Log market volume is not covered.

exploits.label: Exploit Brokers
exploits.note: Disclosure-to-exploitation lag. The broker market itself is not measured and cannot be.

iab.label: Initial Access Brokers
iab.reason: Access listings appear on forums. Requires monitoring that is not yet built.

raas.label: RaaS Operator
raas.note: Group census and activity by month, derived from leak-site claims.

affiliate.label: RaaS Affiliates
affiliate.reason: Affiliates are not distinguishable from operators in any public artifact. Only leaks and indictments separate them, which are events, not a series.

datamkt.label: Underground Data Markets
datamkt.reason: Market listings are observable where the market is reachable. Not built.

leaksite.label: Leak Site Operations
leaksite.note: Posting volume, group count, victim country and sector. The most complete series in the set.

negot.label: Negotiation Services
negot.reason: Negotiation OUTCOMES are published quarterly by incident-response vendors and are not yet ingested. The negotiator population itself remains unmeasurable.

bridge.label: Cross-Chain Bridges
bridge.reason: Chain data is public. Requires on-chain analysis that is not built.

mixers.label: Crypto Mixers
mixers.note: Still maintained by hand. A daily check watches the OFAC list for designations added or removed underneath it.
mixers.reason: Covered by enforcement.json, which a person maintains. Watched for drift by sanctions-drift.json, checked recently.

otc.label: OTC Crypto Brokers
otc.note: Still maintained by hand. A daily check watches the OFAC list for designations added or removed underneath it.
otc.reason: Covered by enforcement.json, exchanges/ profiles, which a person maintains. Watched for drift by sanctions-drift.json, checked recently.

cex.label: Compliant Exchange (Nested)
cex.reason: Covered by exchanges/ profiles, which a person maintains. Nothing would announce it going stale.

ruexch.label: Russia-Based Exchanges
ruexch.note: Still maintained by hand. A daily check watches the OFAC list for designations added or removed underneath it.
ruexch.reason: Covered by enforcement.json, exchanges/ profiles, which a person maintains. Watched for drift by sanctions-drift.json, checked recently.

exchl.label: Non-Compliant Exchanges
exchl.note: Still maintained by hand. A daily check watches the OFAC list for designations added or removed underneath it.
exchl.reason: Covered by enforcement.json, exchanges/ profiles, which a person maintains. Watched for drift by sanctions-drift.json, checked recently.

mules.label: Mule Networks
mules.reason: Mule networks surface only through prosecutions. Events can be logged; no series can exist from public sources.

bankacct.label: Bank Account Transfer
bankacct.reason: Bank transfers are not public. Visible only in court records.

a7a5.label: A7A5 Ruble Settlement Rail
a7a5.reason: A rouble settlement rail with on-chain presence. Public chain data, unbuilt.

fsb.label: FSB Protection
fsb.reason: No public source reports how a security service behaves toward the actors it shelters. Covered only through the accumulating evidentiary record, which measures documents, not relationships.

mvd.label: MVD Dept K
mvd.reason: Domestic prosecutions are published in Russian court records. Labour intensive, not blocked.

rosfin.label: Rosfin Monitoring
rosfin.reason: Published designations and reporting statistics exist. Not built.

cbr.label: CBR 115-FZ
cbr.reason: 115-FZ enforcement actions against banks are published. Not built.

gru.label: GRU Mil. Intel
gru.reason: Same as FSB. No public source reports the relationship.

genpros.label: Prosecutor General
genpros.reason: Covered by Conversion Test (reachability), which a person maintains. Nothing would announce it going stale.

fns.label: FNS Tax Exposure
fns.reason: Russian company and tax records are published and queryable. Labour intensive.

doxing.label: Exposure / Doxxing Actors
doxing.reason: Exposure actors publish openly. Volume and timing are directly observable. Not built.

enab-transit.label: Upstream Transit Carriers
enab-transit.note: Carriers still serving tracked providers, dated disconnections, and successor networks.

enab-registry.label: Registries and Sponsoring LIRs
enab-registry.note: Registry standing and sponsor concentration across tracked networks.

enab-corp.label: Corporate Formation Agents
enab-corp.reason: Company registries are public in most relevant jurisdictions. Labour intensive rather than blocked, and partly automatable.
